sections.lede: Moddable engines are designed to be embedded, extended, and forked. Every tool and engine exposes a clean API for developers.

items.title: Tools API
items.desc: REST API for dice rolls, oracle queries, deck operations, and chess moves. Free, no auth required.

items.title: Chess Engine
items.desc: Embed the chess variant engine in your own app. SVG renderer, AI opponent, and 74 variants.

items.title: Hexmaps Engine
items.desc: Generate, render, and edit hex maps. Seeded RNG, multiple styles, import/export JSON.
